title: calliope_write_container — the answer
description: One container save. noop says nothing was written. An ops save also answers applied, minted and blobIds; a replacements save answers container, counts and slots_changed; an ops save may add routed (edits sent to the origin of a placement) and orphaned (placements left dangling by removing their origin); a notes-tenant save adds the inline-tag outcome (tags, or tags_error when the reconcile failed). A refusal is NOT described here: it is an isError result {code, detail} (refusal.schema.json), and its code is in contracts/refusal-codes.toml.

routed.description: op index to the origin slot an edit through a placement rewrote. Present only when a save routed an edit.

orphaned.description: Placements this call left dangling (each keeps its ref), with the origin they placed. Present only when an origin that had placements was removed or purged with placements "orphan".
